metadata.title: Retail K-Alpha Divergence & Market Overlay
metadata.methodology: Flashpoint AI Affluent Persona Probing + Claude Revealed Preference Scoring

COST.name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
COST.investment_thesis: Affluent members view Costco as a luxury inflation hedge. Despite public macro gloom (stated sentiment -0.42), revealed spending is booming (+0.84 conviction, $350+ basket). Extreme pricing power, 94%+ membership renewals, and zero credit risk make Costco the premier equity expression of the K-shaped recovery.

WMT.name: Walmart Inc.
WMT.investment_thesis: Core lower-income shoppers face severe balance sheet distress (stated -0.78, revealed -0.46). While trade-down drives grocery foot traffic (82% trade-down risk), high grocery revenue mix (~59%) dilutes operating margins. At ~40x forward P/E, valuation reflects optimistic soft-landing assumptions vulnerable to rising delinquency and spending cuts.

TGT.name: Target Corporation
TGT.investment_thesis: Caught in the middle of the K. Middle-income shoppers defer discretionary home and apparel baskets (+0.05 conviction). Valuation is already depressed (16.9x P/E), providing a valuation floor, but top-line growth remains constrained by cautious middle-class basket sizing.

pair_trade_backtest.strategy: Long COST (Right Tail) / Short WMT (Left Tail)

retail_divergence_implications.summary: Across all 4 survey batteries, affluent consumers register confidence readings 44 to 60 points higher than population-weighted headlines. Because top-quartile earners drive ~48% to 50%+ of retail consumer spending, this gap creates a profound distortion in equity pricing:

COST.name: Costco Wholesale Corp.
COST.rationale: Captures resilient high-income bulk discretionary, grocery basket inflation pass-through, and 93%+ renewal rate.

WMT.name: Walmart Inc.
WMT.rationale: High exposure to SNAP cuts, subprime credit strain, and customer discretionary basket deferral.

TGT.name: Target Corp.
TGT.rationale: Middle-income shoppers squeezed on discretionary home/apparel while maintaining steady grocery essentials.

primary_signal.conclusion: Statistically stationary at the 5% level (p=0.0047 < 0.05). Rejects the unit root null hypothesis; suitable for high-conviction factor modeling.

momentum_signal.conclusion: Statistically stationary at the 5% level (p=0.0002 < 0.05). Rejects the unit root null hypothesis; suitable for high-conviction factor modeling.

cointegration_test.conclusion: Cointegrated at the 5% level (Engle-Granger p=0.0182 < 0.05, Residual ADF p=0.0019 < 0.05). A mathematically rigorous long-run equilibrium binds Costco's valuation to Walmart's baseline augmented by the Flashpoint Affluent sentiment wedge.
